_comment: The base class library as the pages show it: each page writes 'case = value' lines (Probe.cs), compared line by line with the original's. Numbers: double/float without a format, negative zero, infinities, parsing, rounding, decimal. Strings: culture-sensitive search and sorting, case mapping, whitespace and Unicode categories, Regex, encodings. Errors: the messages of the exceptions applications show. Cultures: the cultures of cultures.txt, calendars, parsing, time zones by Windows names, the server's local time zone. Serialization: JavaScriptSerializer, DataContractJsonSerializer, XmlSerializer, DataSet, XML as text, HttpUtility and Uri. Bound: doubles and dates through GridView, Eval, Bind, a DropDownList and ViewState, posted back.
